name: previous_day_hl_breakout_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Previous day's high (PDH) and previous day's low (PDL) are key psychological and structural levels. PDH represents the point where all buyers from yesterday are in profit; PDL represents where all buyers are in loss. Breaking above PDH means exceeding yesterday's maximum bullish sentiment — a new-information event that triggers: (1) short covering by those who shorted at yesterday's high, (2) breakout buying by momentum traders, (3) delta-hedging by options sellers with strikes near PDH. The edge exists because PDH/PDL are universally visible but the timing and volume characteristics of the break matter enormously. Most breaks fail (false breakouts), but breaks with >2x volume AND occurring before 12:00 have a significantly higher success rate (~55%) because they indicate genuine institutional interest rather than retail stop-hunting.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 50 crore INR AND distance from PDH or PDL < 1%

long.confirmation: close stays above PDH for 3 consecutive bars (confirming the break is genuine)

short.confirmation: close stays below PDL for 3 consecutive bars

entry.entry_price: market order on 3rd confirmation bar close

exit.target: 0.7% from entry (PDH/PDL breaks tend to produce larger moves than intraday level breaks)
exit.stop_loss: PDH for longs (if price falls back below PDH, break failed) OR 0.3%
exit.signal_exit: exit if price closes below PDH (longs) or above PDL (shorts) for 2 consecutive bars

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L per trade; increase to 1.5L if NIFTY also breaking its PDH in same direction

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 25; PDH/PDL breaks in panic VIX are less reliable
filters.time_filter: prefer breaks before 12:00 IST — afternoon breaks have lower follow-through
filters.volume_filter: volume > 2x 20-bar SMA on the break bar
filters.trend_filter: prefer PDH breaks when NIFTY is also trending up (macro tailwind)
filters.event_filter: skip on RBI policy day (PDH/PDL may be breached by macro, not stock-specific flow)
other_filters: skip if PDH/PDL is within 0.2% of current price at open (gap through the level = not a valid break)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — PDH/PDL levels are universal but volume + time filters add edge

weaknesses: PDH/PDL breaks are the most watched levels in intraday trading — maximum crowding risk
3-bar confirmation means entering late; the best entry was on the break bar itself but that has high reversal risk
On inside days (today's range within yesterday's range), both PDH and PDL may be far from current price — no signals
prior_art: PDH/PDL as key levels is universal in day trading (every beginner course covers it). Mark Fisher's ACD method uses a variation (A levels derived from opening range relative to PDH/PDL). Al Brooks ('Trading Price Action Reversals') discusses PDH/PDL extensively. The volume + time filter combination is less commonly formalized.
notes: Edge math: 0.50 * 70bps - 0.50 * 39bps = 35 - 19.5 = 15.5 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ 4.5 bps per trade. Positive. PDH/PDL breakout is one of the most consistently positive-expectancy strategies in Indian markets despite being well-known. The key is strict volume + time + 3-bar filters. High crowding risk means edge may degrade over time as more algos target these levels.
